biography_sections.title: An inferred younger namesake, not a proved father
biography_sections.markdown:
John senior’s label supports a younger contemporary namesake, but does not state fatherhood. The 1733 Kilroot entry is an administration-bond index, not a read will: no administrator, relative or exact death date survives because the original is lost. John-3959 of Ballyboggy remains an **uncertain working son**; his active 1740 lease chronology excludes treating him as the 1733 deceased-estate person without further evidence.

Source: [PRONI Name Search](https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx).
